== Research Notes ==

A possible identification concerns John Tailzer. The banns/marriage index records Margaret Glasgow and John Tailzer on 18 December 1690 at Walston.<ref>Scotland’s People: Old Parish Registers — banns and marriages: OPR 658/10 / 206; [https://www.scotlandspeople.gov.uk/ record].</ref> The original parish register image has not been inspected. The combined index date does not by itself identify the precise event type. The identification remains uncertain.
